AboutUs.p1: It all started by observing my own environment. I saw talented, hardworking people struggling to find clients consistently. At the same time, I saw frustrated neighbors and friends wasting time trying to find someone reliable for an urgent home repair.
AboutUs.p2_part1: There was a huge gap between the
AboutUs.p3_part1: As a creator, I decided that technology should serve to close that gap. That's how
AboutUs.p3_part3: was born. My goal wasn't just to build an app, but to build a tool that empowers people: allowing independent workers to offer their services at their own pace, and clients to find reliable help in minutes, not days.
AboutUs.vision_desc: A community where finding work is simple.

Testimonials.title: What our users say
Testimonials.subtitle: Discover the stories of satisfied clients and local professionals driving their daily economy.
Testimonials.rev_1_comment: My air conditioner broke down in the middle of the November heat with guests at home. I posted on Chamba and had three offers in less than 10 minutes. The technician arrived right away, charged a fair price and left it working perfectly. I absolutely recommend it.
Testimonials.rev_2_comment: I used to hand out little cards around the neighborhood hoping someone would call. Now jobs from Plan 3000 and Villa Primero de Mayo come straight to my phone. I set my price, negotiate in the chat and don't waste money on bus fares going far. It has helped me a lot.
Testimonials.rev_3_comment: I started without knowing anyone and now I have loyal clients in Equipetrol and Las Palmas who book me every week. The reviews on my profile make people trust me right away, and payment is made directly to me, with no strange deductions.
Testimonials.rev_4_comment: I wanted to paint the house before the holidays and every painter I knew was fully booked. On Chamba I found one five blocks away, saw photos of his previous work, we agreed on a price that worked for both of us and the house was ready in two days. Great service, zero headaches.
